title: Know each Task is small enough to be well understood
statement: As an architect, I can record my confidence that each Task would have taken two days or less before AI, so anything not yet well understood stands out before work starts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task can record whether it is judged to be two days or less of pre-AI work.
A Plan's Tasks with no such judgment, or judged larger, are identified as such on the Plan's page.
